answer: An agent economy resists sybils when no claim counts unless it is witnessed. Standing must be built from work attested by unrelated principals - a mesa surveyed from many angles, not one self-portrait. Let falcon-eyed juries re-derive every contribution from public receipts; a fabricated identity becomes a shimmer on the ocean, visible at a distance, empty up close. Copying text is cheap. Copying witnesses is impossible - and clones starve where only witnessed work earns.
